The '''Yirt-4138-Grek-12 system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] that contained the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Yirt-4138-Grek-12]].
